test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 10 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following states has the Disaster Management Agency and UNICEF jointly developed an online Flood Reporting System and Information Management System?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Assam has the Disaster Management Agency and UNICEF jointly developed an online Flood Reporting System and Information Management System.**
 
• The online system developed jointly by Assam State Disaster Management Agency and UNICEF will replace the existing manual flood control mechanism.
 
• Assam became the 1st Indian state to adopt an Online flood reporting system ·
 
• An online flood reporting and information management system has been launched in Assam__, which faces severe floods every year.
